adhkar.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَحْدَهُ، وَالصَّلاَةُ وَالسَّلاَمُ عَلَى مَنْ لاَ نَبِيَّ بَعْدَهُ
adhkar.translation: All praise is due to Allah alone, and peace and blessings be upon him after whom there is no other Prophet.
adhkar.transliteration: Alḥamdulillahi waḥdah waṣ-ṣalatu was-salam `alā man lā nabiyya ba`dah.
adhkar.virtue: The recommendation to begin supplication with praise to Allah the Exalted and extolling Him, followed by prayers upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
adhkar.source: Anas (RA) said that he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) say: "That I sit with people remembering Almighty Allah from the morning (Fajr) prayer until sunrise is more beloved to me than freeing four slaves from among the Children of Isma'il. That I sit with people remembering Allah from the afternoon ('Asr) prayer, until the sun sets, is more beloved to me than freeing four slaves from among the Children of Isma'il."This was reported by Abu Dawud (No. 3667). Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Abu Dawud 2/698.

adhkar.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾
adhkar.translation: Allah! There is none worthy of worship but He, the Ever-Living, the One Who sustains and protects all that exists. Neither slumber nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is he that can intercede with Him except with His Permission? He knows what happens to them in this world, and what will happen to them in the Hereafter. And they will never encompass anything of His Knowledge except that which He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and He feels no fatigue in guarding and preserving them. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
adhkar.transliteration:
(A`ūdhu billāhi min ash-shaytāni 'r-rajīm)
Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa ‘l-Ḥayyul-Qayyūm,
lā ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa lā nawm,
lahu mā fis-samāwāti wa māfil-arḍ,
man dhal-ladhī yashfa`u `indahu illā bi'idhnih,
ya`lamu mā bayna aydīhim wa mā khalfahum,
wa lā yuḥīṭūna bishay'im-min `ilmihi illā bimā shā',
wasi`a kursiyyuhus-samāwāti wal-arḍ,
wa lā ya'ūduhu hifẓuhumā,
wa huwal-`Aliyyu‘l-`Aẓīm.
adhkar.virtue: (Ayat al-Kursi; Al-Qur'an 2:255) Whoever says this when he rises in the morning will be protected from jinns until he retires in the evening, and whoever says it when retiring in the evening will be protected from them until he rises in the morning.
adhkar.source: It was reported by Al-Hakim 1 / 562, Al-Albani graded it as authentic in Sahihut-Targhib wat-Tarhib 1/273, and traces it to An-Nasa'i and At-Tabarani. He says that At-Tabarani's chain of transmission is reliable (Jayyid).

adhkar.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ ﴿آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلآئِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لاَ نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ* لاَ يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْساً إِلاَّ وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْراً كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لاَ طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلاَنَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ﴾. [البقرة 285 - 286]
adhkar.translation: (285) The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], We make no distinction between any of His messengers. And they say, We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination. (286) Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.
adhkar.transliteration:
Aamanar-Rasoolu bimaaa unzila ilaihi mir-Rabbihee walmu'minoon; kullun aamana billaahi wa Malaaa'ikathihee wa Kutubhihee wa Rusulihee laa nufarriqu baina ahadim-mir-Rusulih wa qaaloo sami'naa wa ata'naa ghufraanaka Rabbanaa wa ilaikal-maseer (285)
Laa yukalliful-laahu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa; lahaa maa kasabat wa 'alaihaa maktasabat; Rabbanaa laa tu'aakhiznaaa in naseenaaa aw akhtaanaa; Rabbanaa wa laa tahmil-'alainaaa isran kamaa hamaltahoo 'alal-lazeena min qablinaa; Rabbanaa wa laa tuhammilnaa maa laa taaqata lanaa bih; wa'fu 'annaa waghfir lanaa warhamnaa; Anta mawlaanaa fansurnaa 'alal qawmil kaafireen (286)
adhkar.virtue: Al-Baqarah 2:285-6. These two Verses will be sufficient for anyone who recites them at night before sleeping.
adhkar.source: It was narrated by Al-Bukhari, No. 4008, and Muslim, No. 807.

adhkar.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ، ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ، لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
adhkar.translation: (1) Say, He is Allah, [who is] One, (2) Allah, the Eternal Refuge.(3) He neither begets nor is born,(4) Nor is there to Him any equivalent.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismillaahir Rahmaanir Raheem "Qul huwal laahu ahad (1) Allah hus-samad (2) Lam yalid wa lam yoolad (3) Wa lam yakul-lahoo kufuwan ahad (4)
adhkar.virtue: Al-Ikhlas 112:1-4, Al-Falaq 113:1-5, An-Nas 114:1-6. Whoever recites these three times in the morning and in the evening, they will suffice him (as a protection) against everything.
adhkar.source: The Hadith was reported by Abu Dawud 4/322, and At-Tirmidhi 5/567. See Al-Albani's Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/182.

adhkar.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ، مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ، وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ، وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
adhkar.translation: (1) Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak (2) From the evil of that which He created (3) And from the evil of darkness when it settles (4) And from the evil of the blowers in knots (5) And from the evil of an envier when he envies.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismillaahir Rahmaanir Raheem "Qul a'oozu bi rabbil-falaq (1) Min sharri maa khalaq (2) Wa min sharri ghaasiqin izaa waqab (3) Wa min sharrin-naffaa-taati fil 'uqad (4) Wa min sharri haasidin izaa hasad (5)
adhkar.virtue: Al-Ikhlas 112:1-4, Al-Falaq 113:1-5, An-Nas 114:1-6. Whoever recites these three times in the morning and in the evening, they will suffice him (as a protection) against everything.
adhkar.source: The Hadith was reported by Abu Dawud 4/322, and At-Tirmidhi 5/567. See Al-Albani's Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/182.

adhkar.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ، مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ، إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ، مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ، ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ، مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
adhkar.translation: (1) Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind (2) The Sovereign of mankind (3) The God of mankind (4) From the evil of the retreating whisperer (5) Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind (6) From among the jinn and mankind.
adhkar.transliteration:
Bismillaahir Rahmaanir Raheem "Qul a'oozu birabbin naas (1)
Malikin naas (2)
Ilaahin naas (3)
Min sharril waswaasil khannaas (4)
Allazee yuwaswisu fee sudoorin naas (5)
Minal jinnati wannaas (6)
adhkar.virtue: Al-Ikhlas 112:1-4, Al-Falaq 113:1-5, An-Nas 114:1-6. Whoever recites these three times in the morning and in the evening, they will suffice him (as a protection) against everything.
adhkar.source: The Hadith was reported by Abu Dawud 4/322, and At-Tirmidhi 5/567. See Al-Albani's Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/182.

adhkar.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْملْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْملْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
adhkar.translation: We have reached the morning and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I take refuge in You from laziness and senility. My Lord, I take refuge in You from torment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.
adhkar.transliteration: Asbahna wa-asbahal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer, rabbi as-aluka khayra ma fee hathal-yawm, wakhayra ma baAAdahu, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri hathal-yawm, washarri ma baAAdahu, rabbi aAAoothu bika minal-kasal, wasoo-il kibar, rabbi aAAoothu bika min AAathabin fin-nar, waAAathabin fil-qabr.

adhkar.arabic: أمسينا وأمسى الملك للَّه، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رب أسألك خير ما في هذه الليلة، وخير ما بعدها، وأعوذ بك من شر ما في هذه الليلة، وشر ما بعدها، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
adhkar.translation: We have reached the evening and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it and I take refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I take refuge in You from laziness and senility. My Lord, I take refuge in You from torment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.
adhkar.transliteration: Amsayna wa-amsal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer, rabbi as-aluka khayra ma fee hathihil-laylah, wakhayra ma baAAdaha, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri hathihil-laylah, washarri ma baAAdaha, rabbi aAAoothu bika minal-kasal, wasoo-il kibar, rabbi aAAoothu bika min AAathabin fin-nar, waAAathabin fil-qabr.

adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the morning and by Your leave we have reached the evening, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our resurrection
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna, wabika amsayna, wabika nahya, wabika namootu wa-ilaykan-nushoor.
adhkar.source: Al-Tirmidhi, 5/466, No. 3391, and see: Sahih Al-Tirmidhi 3/142.

adhkar.arabic: اللَّهمَّ بِكَ أمسَينا وبِكَ أصبَحنا وبِكَ نَحيا وبِكَ نموتُ، وإليكَ المصيرُ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the evening and by Your leave we have reached the morning, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our return.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma bika amsayna, wabika asbahna, wabika nahya, wabika namootu wa-ilaykal-maseer.
adhkar.source: Al-Tirmidhi, 5/466, No. 3391, and see: Sahih Al-Tirmidhi 3/142.

adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You, You created me and I am Your servant and I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can, I take refuge in You from the evil of which I have committed.  I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for verily none can forgive sin except You.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbee la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtanee wa-ana AAabduk, wa-ana AAala AAahdika wawaAAdika mas-tataAAt, aAAoothu bika min sharri ma sanaAAt, aboo-o laka biniAAmatika AAalay, wa-aboo-o bithanbee, faghfir lee fa-innahu la yaghfiruth-thunooba illa ant.
adhkar.virtue: Whoever recites this with conviction in the evening and dies during that night shall enter Paradise, and whoever recites it with conviction in the morning and dies during that day shall enter Paradise
adhkar.source: Narrated by Al-Bukhari, 7/150, No. 6306.

adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلاَئِكَتَكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, verily I have reached the morning and call on You, the bearers of Your throne, Your angels, and all of Your creation to witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except You, alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is Your Servant and Messenger.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee asbahtu oshhiduka, wa-osshidu hamalata AAarshika, wamala-ikatika, wajameeAAa khalqika, annaka antal-lahu la ilaha illa ant, wahdaka la shareeka lak, wa-anna Muhammadan AAabduka warasooluka.
adhkar.virtue: Allah will spare whoever says this four times in the morning or evening from the fire of Hell.
adhkar.source: It was narrated by Abu Dawood, 4/317, No. 5069, and by Al-Bukhari in Al-Adab Al-Mufrad, No. 1201, and by Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 9, and by Ibn Al-Sunni, No. 70. Sheikh Ibn Baz classified the isnad of Al-Nasa'i and Abu Dawood as hasan in Tuhfat Al-Akhyar, p. 23.

adhkar.arabic: اللَّهم إني أمسيت أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلاَئِكَتَكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, verily I have reached the evening and call on You, the bearers of Your throne, Your angels, and all of Your creation to witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except You, alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is Your Servant and Messenger.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee amsaytu oshhiduka, wa-osshidu hamalata AAarshika, wamala-ikatika, wajameeAAa khalqika, annaka antal-lahu la ilaha illa ant, wahdaka la shareeka lak, wa-anna Muhammadan AAabduka warasooluka.
adhkar.virtue: Allah will spare whoever says this four times in the morning or evening from the fire of Hell.
adhkar.source: It was narrated by Abu Dawood, 4/317, No. 5069, and by Al-Bukhari in Al-Adab Al-Mufrad, No. 1201, and by Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 9, and by Ibn Al-Sunni, No. 70. Sheikh Ibn Baz classified the isnad of Al-Nasa'i and Abu Dawood as hasan in Tuhfat Al-Akhyar, p. 23.

adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, what blessing I or any of Your creation have risen upon is from You alone, without partner. So for You is all praise and unto You all thanks.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma ma asbaha bee min niAAmatin, aw bi-ahadin min khalqika, faminka wahdaka la shareeka lak, falakal-hamdu walakash-shukr.
adhkar.virtue: Whoever recites this in the morning, has completed his obligation to thank Allah for that day; and whoever says it in the evening, has completed his obligation for that night.
adhkar.source: It was narrated by Abu Dawood, 4/318, No. 5073, and by Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 7, and by Ibn Al-Sunni, No. 41, and by Ibn Hibban in Mawarid, No. 2361. Sheikh Ibn Baz classified the isnad as hasan in Tuhfat Al-Akhyar, p. 24.

adhkar.arabic: اللَّهم ما أمسى بي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, what blessing I or any of Your creation have reached the evening upon is from You alone, without partner. So for You is all praise and unto You all thanks
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma ma amsa bee min niAAmatin, aw bi-ahadin min khalqika, faminka wahdaka la shareeka lak, falakal-hamdu walakash-shukr.
adhkar.virtue: Whoever recites this in the morning, has completed his obligation to thank Allah for that day; and whoever says it in the evening, has completed his obligation for that night.
adhkar.source: It was narrated by Abu Dawood, 4/318, No. 5073, and by Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 7, and by Ibn Al-Sunni, No. 41, and by Ibn Hibban in Mawarid, No. 2361. Sheikh Ibn Baz classified the isnad as hasan in Tuhfat Al-Akhyar, p. 24.

adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ، وَالفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
adhkar.translation: (O Allah, grant my body health, O Allah, grant my hearing health, O Allah, grant my sight health.  None has the right to be worshipped except You.) (O Allah, I take refuge with You from disbelief and poverty, and I take refuge with You from the punishment of the grave.  None has the right to be worshipped except You.)
adhkar.transliteration: (Allahumma AAafinee fee badanee, allahumma AAafinee fee samAAee, allahumma AAafinee fee basaree, la ilaha illa ant.) (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-kufr, walfaqr, wa-aAAoothu bika min AAathabil-qabr, la ilaha illa ant.)
adhkar.source: Abu Dawud 4/324, Ahmad 5/42, An-Nasa'i, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah (No. 22), Ibn As-Sunni (No. 69), Al-Bukhari Al-'Adab Al-Mufrad. Its chain of transmission is good (Hasan), Ibn Baz, p. 26.

adhkar.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ عَلَيهِ تَوَكَّلتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
adhkar.translation: Allah is Sufficient for me, none has the right to be worshipped except Him, upon Him I rely and He is Lord of the exalted throne.
adhkar.transliteration: Hasbiyal-lahu la ilaha illa huwa, AAalayhi tawakkalt, wahuwa rabbul-AAarshil-AAatheem
adhkar.virtue: Allah will grant whoever recites this seven times in the morning or evening whatever he desires from this world or the next
adhkar.source: It was narrated by Ibn As-Sunni, No. 71, attributed directly to the Prophet (Marfu'), and by Abu Dawud as a statement of a Companion (Mawquf), 4/321, No. 5081. The chain of transmission was authenticated by Shu'ayb and 'Abd al-Qadir al-Arna'ut. See: Zad Al-Ma'ad 2/376.

adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ: فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي، وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَينِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this life and the next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religious and worldly affairs, and my family and my wealth. O Allah, veil my weaknesses and set at ease my dismay. O Allah, preserve me from the front and from behind and on my right and on my left and from above, and I take refuge with You lest I be swallowed up by the earth.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee as-alukal-AAafwa walAAafiyah, fid-dunya wal-akhirah, allahumma innee as-alukal-AAafwa walAAafiyah fee deenee, wadunyaya wa-ahlee, wamalee, allahummas-tur AAawratee, wa-amin rawAAatee, allahummah-fathnee min bayni yaday, wamin khalfee, waAAan yameenee, waAAan shimalee, wamin fawqee, wa-aAAoothu biAAathamatika an oghtala min tahtee.
adhkar.source: Abu Dawood, No. 5074, and Ibn Majah, No. 3871. See: Sahih Ibn Majah, 2/332.

adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشَرَكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
adhkar.translation: (O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the Earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil and shirk of the devil, and from committing wrong against my soul or bringing such upon another Muslim.)(shirk: to associate others with Allah in those things which are specific to Him.  This can occur in (1) belief, e.g. to believe that other than Allah has the power to benefit or harm, (2) speech, e.g. to swear by other than Allah and (3) action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than Allah.)
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma AAalimal-ghaybi washshahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shayin wamaleekah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, aAAoothu bika min sharri nafsee wamin sharrish-shaytani washirkih, waan aqtarifa AAala nafsee soo-an aw ajurrahu ila muslim.
adhkar.source: Al-Tirmidhi, No. 3392, and Abu Dawood, No. 5067. See: Sahih Al-Tirmidhi, 3/142.

adhkar.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah with whose name nothing is harmed on earth nor in the heavens and He is The All-Seeing, The All-Knowing.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismil-lahil-lathee la yadurru maAAas-mihi shay-on fil-ardi wala fis-sama-i wahuwas-sameeAAul-AAaleem.
adhkar.virtue: Whoever recites it three times in the morning will not be afflicted by any calamity before evening, and whoever recites it three times in the evening will not be overtaken by any calamity before morning.
adhkar.source: It was narrated by Abu Dawood, 4/323, No. 5088, Al-Tirmidhi, 5/465, No. 3388, Ibn Majah, No. 3869, and Ahmad, No. 446. See: Sahih Ibn Majah, 2/332. Sheikh Ibn Baz classified the isnad as hasan in Tuhfat Al-Akhyar, p. 39.

adhkar.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبَّاً، وَبِالْإِسْلاَمِ دِيناً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَبِيًّا
adhkar.translation: I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, and Islam as a religion and Muhammad  as a Prophet.
adhkar.transliteration: Radeetu billahi rabban wabil-islami deenan wabiMuhammadin nabiyya.
adhkar.virtue: Allah has promised that anyone who says this three times every morning or evening will be pleased on the Day of Resurrection.
adhkar.source: Ahmad, 4/337, No. 18967, Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 4, Ibn Al-Sunni, No. 68, Abu Dawood, 4/318, No. 1531, and Al-Tirmidhi, 5/465, No. 3389. Sheikh Ibn Baz classified it as hasan in Tuhfat Al-Akhyar, p. 39.

adhkar.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِيَ كُلَّهُ وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
adhkar.translation: O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, by Your mercy I seek assistance, rectify for me all of my affairs and do not leave me to myself, even for the blink of an eye.
adhkar.transliteration: Ya hayyu ya qayyoom, birahmatika astagheeth, aslih lee sha/nee kullah, wala takilnee ila nafsee tarfata AAayn.
adhkar.source: Its chain of transmission is sound (Sahih), Al-Hakim 1/545, see Albani, Sahihut-Targhib wat-Tarhib, 1/273.

adhkar.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ: فَتْحَهُ، وَنَصْرَهُ، وَنورَهُ، وَبَرَكَتَهُ، وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
adhkar.translation: We have reached the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil that follows it.
adhkar.transliteration: Asbahna wa-asbahal-mulku lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, allahumma innee as-aluka khayra hathal-yawm, fat-hahu, wanasrahu, wanoorahu, wabarakatahu, wahudahu, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri ma feehi, washarri ma baAAdah.
adhkar.source: Abu Dawud 4/322. Its transmission chain is good (Hasan). See also Ibn Al-Qayyim, Zadul- Ma'ad 2/273.

adhkar.arabic: أَمْسَيْنا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ للهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمَيْنِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّي أسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَه اللَّيْلَةِ فَتْحَهَا ونَصْرَهَا، ونُوْرَهَا وبَرَكَتهَا، وَهُدَاهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فيهِا وَشَرَّ مَا بَعْدَهَا
adhkar.translation: We have reached the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of tonight, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of tonight and the evil that follows it.
adhkar.transliteration: Amsayna wa-amsal-mulku lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, allahumma innee as-aluka khayra hathihil-laylah, fat-haha, wanasraha, wanooraha, wabarakataha, wahudaha, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri ma feeha, washarri ma baAAdaha.
adhkar.source: Abu Dawud 4/322. Its transmission chain is good (Hasan). See also Ibn Al-Qayyim, Zadul- Ma'ad 2/273.

adhkar.arabic: أَصْبَحْنا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشرِكِينَ
adhkar.translation: We rise upon the fitrah of Islam, and the word of pure faith, and upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and the religion of our forefather Ibraheem, who was a Muslim and of true faith and was not of those who associate others with Allah.
adhkar.transliteration: Asbahna AAala fitratil-islam, waAAala kalimatil-ikhlas, waAAala deeni nabiyyina Muhammad ﷺ, waAAala millati abeena Ibraheem, haneefan musliman wama kana minal-mushrikeen.
adhkar.source: Ahmad, 3/406 and 407, nos. 15360 and 15563, and Ibn Al-Sunni in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 34. See: Sahih Al-Jami', 4/209.

adhkar.arabic: أمسينا على فطرة الإسلام، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشرِكِينَ
adhkar.translation: We have entered the evening upon the fitrah of Islam, and the word of pure faith, and upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and the religion of our forefather Ibraheem, who was a Muslim and of true faith and was not of those who associate others with Allah.
adhkar.transliteration: Amsayna AAala fitratil-islam, waAAala kalimatil-ikhlas, waAAala deeni nabiyyina Muhammad ﷺ, waAAala millati abeena Ibraheem, haneefan musliman wama kana minal-mushrikeen.
adhkar.source: Ahmad, 3/406 and 407, nos. 15360 and 15563, and Ibn Al-Sunni in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 34. See: Sahih Al-Jami', 4/209.

adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً، وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which is beneficial and sustenance which is good, and deeds which are acceptable.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee as-aluka AAilman nafiAAan, warizqan tayyiban, waAAamalan mutaqabbalan.
adhkar.source: It was narrated by Ibn Al-Sunni in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 54, and by Ibn Majah, No. 925. The chain of transmission was classified as hasan by 'Abd al-Qadir and Shu'ayb al-Arna'ut in their verification of Zad Al-Ma'ad, 2/375.

adhkar.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
adhkar.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
adhkar.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer.
adhkar.repeatLabel: Ten times or once when lazy
adhkar.virtue: Ten times or once when feeling lazy, and whoever says it ten times, it is as if he has freed four souls from the descendants of Isma'il.
adhkar.source: Sahih Al-Bukhari: 6404, Sahih Muslim: 2693, Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 24. See: Sahih Al-Targhib wal-Tarhib, 1/272, Tuhfat Al-Akhyar by Ibn Baz, p. 44, and its virtue in: p. 146, hadith No. 255. Once when feeling lazy: Abu Dawood, No. 5077, Ibn Majah, No. 3798, Ahmad, No. 8719. See: Sahih Al-Targhib wal-Tarhib, 1/270, Sahih Abi Dawood, 3/957, Sahih Ibn Majah, 2/331, and Zad Al-Ma'ad, 2/377.

adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبَيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
adhkar.translation: O Allaah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.
adhkar.transliteration: Allaahumma salli wa sallim 'alaa Nabiyyinaa Muhammadin
adhkar.virtue: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Who recites blessings upon me ten times in the morning and ten times in the evening will obtain my intercession on the Day of Resurrection.
adhkar.source: It was narrated by Al-Tabarani with two isnads, one of which is good. See: Majma' Al-Zawa'id, 10/120, and Sahih Al-Targhib wal-Tarhib, 1/273 [No. 656], and Da'if Al-Targhib wal-Tarhib, No. 396, and in Al-Silsilah Al-Da'ifah, No. 5788.

adhkar.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
adhkar.translation: I take refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil He has created.
adhkar.transliteration: aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
adhkar.virtue: Whoever recites this three times in the evening will be protected from insect stings
adhkar.source: Ahmad 2/ 290, An-Nasa'i, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah No. 590, At-Tirmidhi 3/187, Ibn As-Sunni No. 68. According to Al-Albani, Ibn Majah's (2/266) chain of transmission is sound (Sahih), and following Ibn Baz 45, At-Tirmidhi's report is good (Hasan).

adhkar.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ: عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
adhkar.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him by the number of His creation and His pleasure, and by the weight of His throne, and the ink of His words.
adhkar.transliteration: Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih, AAadada khalqihi warida nafsih, wazinata AAarshih, wamidada kalimatih.

adhkar.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
adhkar.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
adhkar.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer.
adhkar.virtue: Whoever recites this one hundred times a day will have the reward of freeing ten slaves. One hundred Hasanaat (rewards) will be written for him and one hundred misdeeds will be washed away. He will be shielded from Satan until the evening. No one will be able to present anything better than this except for someone who has recited more than this.
adhkar.source: Al-Bukhari, 4/95, No. 3293, and Muslim, 4/2071, No. 2691. Ten times: Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 24. See: Sahih Al-Targhib wal-Tarhib, 1/272, and Tuhfat Al-Akhyar by Ibn Baz, p. 44, and its virtue in: p. 146, hadith No. 255. Once when feeling lazy: Abu Dawood, No. 5077, Ibn Majah, No. 3798, Ahmad, No. 8719. See: Sahih Al-Targhib wal-Tarhib, 1/270, Sahih Abi Dawood, 3/957, Sahih Ibn Majah, 2/331, and Zad Al-Ma'ad, 2/377.

adhkar.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
adhkar.translation: I seek Allaah’s forgiveness and I turn to Him in repentance.
adhkar.transliteration: Astaghfirullaaha wa 'atoobu 'ilayhi
adhkar.source: Al-Bukhari with Al-Fath, 11/101 [No. 6307], and Muslim, 4/2075 [No. 2702].

adhkar.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
adhkar.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.
adhkar.transliteration: Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih.
adhkar.virtue: Whoever recites this one hundred times in the morning and in the evening will not be surpassed on the Day of Resurrection by anyone having done better than this except for someone who had recited it more.
adhkar.source: Muslim 2692.

adhkar.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
adhkar.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah.
adhkar.transliteration: astaghfirullah
adhkar.virtue: Istighfar — When the Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, finished his prayer, he would seek forgiveness three times and recite the dhikr above. Al-Auza'i stated that the recitation of istighfar is 'Astaghfirullah, Astaghfirullah.'
adhkar.source: HR. Muslim No. 591

adhkar.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَاْلإِكْرَامِ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, You are Peace, and from You is peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honor.
adhkar.transliteration: allahumma antas-salam wa minkas-salam tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram
adhkar.virtue: Allah, The Giver of Peace — When the Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, finished his prayer, he would seek forgiveness three times and recite the dhikr above. Al-Auza'i stated that the recitation of istighfar is 'Astaghfirullah, Astaghfirullah.'
adhkar.source: HR. Muslim No. 591

adhkar.arabic: لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرُ، اَللَّهُمَّ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
adhkar.translation: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things competent. O Allah, there is no preventer of what You give, and no giver of what You withhold, and wealth and honor do not benefit their possessor (except faith and righteous deeds that save from punishment). Only from You is wealth and honor.
adhkar.transliteration: la ilaha illa allah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. allahumma la mani'a lima a'tayta wa la mu'tiya lima mana'ta wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jaddu
adhkar.virtue: Allah, The Preventer and The Giver of All Things
adhkar.source: HR. Bukhari No. 844 and Muslim No. 593

adhkar.arabic: لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرُ. لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللهِ، لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ اللهُ، وَلاَ نَعْبُدُ إِلاَّ إِيَّاهُ، لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ، لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ اللهُ مُخْلِصِيْنَ لَهُ الدِّيْنَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُوْنَ
adhkar.translation: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things competent. There is no power and no strength except by Allah. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, and we do not worship except Him. To Him belongs all favor, grace, and good praise. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, making our religion sincerely for Him, even if the disbelievers dislike it.
adhkar.transliteration: la ilaha illa allah wahdahu la sharika lah. lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah. la ilaha illa allah wa la na'budu illa iyyah. lahun-ni'mah wa lahul-fadl wa lahuth-thana'ul-hasan. la ilaha illa allah mukhlisina lahud-dina wa law karihal-kafirun
adhkar.virtue: Allah, The Possessor of All and The Only One Worthy of Worship — 'Abdullah bin Zubair said, "The Prophet, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, used to recite the tahlil (laa ilaha illallah) at the end of the prayer."
adhkar.source: HR. Muslim No. 594

adhkar.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ
adhkar.translation: Glory be to Allah
adhkar.transliteration: subhanallah
adhkar.virtue: Tasbih

adhkar.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
adhkar.translation: All praise is for Allah
adhkar.transliteration: alhamdulillah
adhkar.virtue: Tahmid

adhkar.arabic: اللهُ أَكْبَرُ
adhkar.translation: Allah is the Greatest
adhkar.transliteration: allahu akbar
adhkar.virtue: Takbir

adhkar.arabic: لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرُ
adhkar.translation: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things competent.
adhkar.transliteration: la ilaha illa allah wahdahu la sharika lah. lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
adhkar.virtue: There is No Partner for Allah, and To Him Belongs All Things — Whoever recites the dhikr above, his sins will be forgiven, even if they are as numerous as the foam on the ocean. Imam Nawawi, may Allah have mercy on him, said that the text of the hadith indicates that 'Subhanallah', 'Alhamdulillah', and 'Allahu akbar' are each recited 33 times separately.
adhkar.source: Sharh Shahih Muslim, 5: 84

adhkar.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
adhkar.translation: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
adhkar.transliteration: allahu la ilaha illa huwa, al-hayyul-qayyum. la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm. lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnihi. ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum. wa la yuhituna bishay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha'. wa si'a kursiyyuhu as-samawati wal-ard. wa la ya'udu-hu hifdhuhuma. wa huwa al-'aliyyul-'azim
adhkar.virtue: Ayat al-Kursi — Whoever recites Ayat al-Kursi after finishing the prayer, nothing will prevent him from entering Paradise except death.
adhkar.source: HR. an-Nasai in Al-Kubro 9: 44. This hadith is declared sahih by Ibn Hibban, as mentioned by Ibn Hajar in Bulugh al-Maram

adhkar.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ (1) ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ (2) لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ (3) وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ (4)
adhkar.translation: Say, "He is Allah , [who is] One, (1) Allah , the Eternal Refuge. (2) He neither begets nor is born, (3) Nor is there to Him any equivalent." (4)
adhkar.transliteration: qul huwa allahu ahad (1) allahu samad (2) lam yalid wa lam yulad (3) wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad (4)
adhkar.virtue: Al-Ikhlas — The Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, said: Recite Qul huwallahu ahad, and Al-Mu'awwidhatayn (Al-Falaq and An-Nas) in the evening and morning three times, and it will suffice you (protect you) from everything.
adhkar.source: HR. Abu Dawud No. 1523 and an-Nasa'i No. 1337. Al-Hafiz Abu Tahir said that the chain of this hadith is hasan

adhkar.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ (1) مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ (2) وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ (3) وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ (4) وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ (5)
adhkar.translation: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak (1) From the evil of that which He created (2) And from the evil of darkness when it settles (3) And from the evil of the blowers in knots (4) And from the evil of an envier when he envies." (5)
adhkar.transliteration: qul a'udhu birabbil-falaq (1) min sharri ma khalaq (2) wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab (3) wa min sharri naffathati fil-'uqad (4) wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad (5)
adhkar.virtue: Al-Falaq — The Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, said: Recite Qul huwallahu ahad, and Al-Mu'awwidhatayn (Al-Falaq and An-Nas) in the evening and morning three times, and it will suffice you (protect you) from everything.
adhkar.source: HR. Abu Dawud No. 1523 and an-Nasa'i No. 1337. Al-Hafiz Abu Tahir said that the chain of this hadith is hasan

adhkar.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ (1) مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ (2) إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ (3) مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ (4) ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ (5) مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ (6)
adhkar.translation: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, (1) The King of mankind. (2) The God of mankind, (3) From the evil of the whisperer who withdraws, (4) Who whispers in the breasts of mankind, (5) Of the jinn and mankind." (6)
adhkar.transliteration: qul a'udhu birabbin-nas (1) malikin-nas (2) ilahin-nas (3) min sharri al-waswasi al-khannas (4) alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas (5) mina al-jinnati wan-nas (6)
adhkar.virtue: An-Nas — The Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, said: Recite Qul huwallahu ahad, and Al-Mu'awwidhatayn (Al-Falaq and An-Nas) in the evening and morning three times, and it will suffice you (protect you) from everything.
adhkar.source: HR. Abu Dawud No. 1523 and an-Nasa'i No. 1337. Al-Hafiz Abu Tahir said that the chain of this hadith is hasan

adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّى أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.
adhkar.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan
adhkar.virtue: Supplication for Beneficial Knowledge, Good Provision, and Accepted Deeds — Beneficial knowledge is a provision that makes life easier, obtaining good provision is a person's goal in working, and accepted deeds are the hope of every person who performs good deeds. Therefore, a servant should always ask for these 3 things every morning before starting their various activities.
adhkar.source: HR. Ibn Majah No. 925 and Ahmad 6: 305, 322. Al-Hafiz Abu Tahir said that this hadith is sahih

adhkar.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوْتُ وَأَحْيَا
adhkar.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
adhkar.transliteration: bismika allahumma amutu wa ahya
adhkar.virtue: Supplication Before Sleeping — The Prophet, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, always started and ended his day with dhikr.
adhkar.source: HR. al-Bukhari

adhkar.arabic: الحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بعْدَ مَا أماتَنَا وإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
adhkar.translation: All praise is for Allah who gives us life after He has caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.
adhkar.transliteration: alhamdulillahilladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur
adhkar.virtue: Supplication Upon Waking Up — By reciting the supplication above, a servant begins his day by praising the name of Allah, the Giver of Life and the Bringer of Death.
adhkar.source: HR. Bukhari: 6327

adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil and the wicked.
adhkar.transliteration: allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khubuthi wal-khaba'ith
adhkar.virtue: Supplication Entering the Bathroom — This supplication acts as a barrier between a servant's private parts and the jinn when entering the bathroom.
adhkar.source: HR. al-Bukhari and Muslim

adhkar.arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
adhkar.translation: I ask for Your forgiveness (O Allah).
adhkar.transliteration: ghufranak
adhkar.virtue: Supplication Leaving the Bathroom — The bathroom is one of the homes of the jinn and devils, so it is recommended to ask for forgiveness for any mistakes, intentional or unintentional, made while in the bathroom.
adhkar.source: HR. at-Tirmidzi

adhkar.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah.
adhkar.transliteration: bismillah
adhkar.virtue: Supplication Before Eating — The benefit of reciting Bismillah before eating is to prevent Satan from joining humans in eating.
adhkar.source: HR. al-Bukari No. 5376 and Muslim No. 2022

adhkar.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah, at its beginning and its end.
adhkar.transliteration: bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu
adhkar.virtue: Supplication If Forgetting Bismillah at the Beginning of a Meal — Islam pays great attention to etiquette. If someone forgets to recite the supplication before eating at the beginning, it is still recommended to recite it in the middle, even if there is only a spoonful of rice left.
adhkar.source: HR. Abu Dawud

adhkar.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِى أَطْعَمَنِى هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّى وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ
adhkar.translation: All praise is to Allah who has fed me this and provided for me without any power or strength from me.
adhkar.transliteration: alhamdulillahilladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah
adhkar.virtue: Supplication After Eating — The Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, said that if someone recites this supplication, then his past sins will be forgiven.
adhkar.source: Shahih at-Tirmidzi

adhkar.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِيْ أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, open the doors of Your mercy for me.
adhkar.transliteration: allahummaftah li abwaba rahmatik
adhkar.virtue: Supplication Entering the Mosque — The mosque is the house of Allah; a servant should honor it and hope for Allah's mercy within it.
adhkar.source: HR. Muslim

adhkar.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for Your bounty.
adhkar.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik
adhkar.virtue: Supplication Leaving the Mosque — Allah's earth is vast, and there are many ways to seek provision. A servant should ask for Allah's bounty to be facilitated in obtaining the provision that Allah has distributed to all His servants.
adhkar.source: HR. Muslim No. 713

adhkar.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah.
adhkar.transliteration: bismillah
adhkar.virtue: Supplication Before Performing Ablution — It is prescribed to begin every important matter by saying Bismillah, whether it be an act of worship or otherwise.
adhkar.source: HR. at-Tirmidzi and al-Baihaqi

adhkar.arabic: أشْهَدُ أنْ لا إله إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَرِيك لَهُ ، وأشْهَدُ أنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَوَّابِينَ ، واجْعَلْني مِنَ المُتَطَهِّرِينَ ، سُبْحانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وبِحَمْدِكَ ، أشْهَدُ أنْ لا إلهَ إِلاَّ أنْتَ ، أسْتَغْفِرُكَ وأتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
adhkar.translation: I bear witness that there is no deity except Allah alone, with no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. O Allah, make me among those who repent and make me among those who purify themselves. Glory be to You, O Allah, and with Your praise, I bear witness that there is no deity except You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
adhkar.transliteration: ashhadu alla ilaha illa allah wahdahu la sharika lahu, wa ashhadu anna muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh. allahummaj'alni minat-tawwabina waj'alni minal-mutatahhirin. subhanakallahumma wa bihamdika ashhadu alla ilaha illa anta astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk
adhkar.virtue: Supplication After Performing Ablution — Whoever recites this supplication, eight gates of Paradise will be opened for him, and he may enter from whichever gate he wishes.
adhkar.source: HR. Muslim, at-Tirmidzi and an-Nasa'i

adhkar.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وثَبَتَ اْلأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَاللهُ
adhkar.translation: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, Insha Allah.
adhkar.transliteration: dhahabadh-dhama'u wabtallatil-'uruqu wa thabatal-ajru insha allah
adhkar.virtue: Supplication for Breaking the Fast — It is highly recommended for those who are fasting to increase their supplications before and after breaking the fast, because the supplication of a fasting person is one of the three supplications that are not rejected.
adhkar.source: HR. Abu Daud, As-Sunan Al-Kubra Lil Baihaqi, Vol. 4, p. 239, al-Hakim in Mustadrak 'alas Shahihain No. 1484

adhkar.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ
adhkar.translation: Peace be upon you.
adhkar.transliteration: assalamu 'alaykum
adhkar.virtue: Supplication Entering the House #1 — The greeting is a supplication of hope, a hope that you will be safe from all kinds of sorrow and suffering, and be enveloped in mercy and blessings.
adhkar.source: HR. at-Tirmidzi

adhkar.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَا تُهُ
adhkar.translation: Peace, mercy, and blessings of Allah be upon you.
adhkar.transliteration: assalamu 'alaykum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh
adhkar.virtue: Supplication Entering the House #2 — The greeting is a supplication of hope, a hope that you will be safe from all kinds of sorrow and suffering, and be enveloped in mercy and blessings.
adhkar.source: HR. at-Tirmidzi

adhkar.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah. There is no might nor power except with Allah.
adhkar.transliteration: bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
adhkar.virtue: Supplication Leaving the House — Whoever recites this supplication, it will be said to him: "You will be guided, sufficed, and protected." Satan will then depart from him. Another satan will say: "How can you harm someone who has been guided, sufficed, and protected?!"
adhkar.source: HR. Abu Dawud and at-Tirmidzi

adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّى أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ أَوْ أُضَلَّ أَوْ أَزِلَّ أَوْ أُزَلَّ أَوْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ أَوْ أَجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَىَّ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I should stray or be led astray, slip or be tripped, wrong or be wronged, or act foolishly or have foolishness done to me.
adhkar.transliteration: allahumma inni a'udhu bika an adilla aw udalla, aw azilla aw uzalla, aw adhlima aw udhlama, aw ajhala aw yujhala 'alayya
adhkar.virtue: Supplication for Protection from Causing or Experiencing Harm Outside the House — When a person leaves the house, they will encounter all kinds of things, both good and bad, especially harm caused by themselves. Therefore, it is commanded to seek refuge from oneself and from others.
adhkar.source: HR. Abu Dawud, at-Tirmidzi, Ibn Majah and an-Nasa'i

adhkar.arabic: الله أَكْبَرُ،الله أَكْبَرُ،الله أَكْبَرُ،سُبْحَانَ الَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِى سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِى السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِى الأَهْلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّى أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِى الْمَالِ وَالأَهْلِ
adhkar.translation: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. Glory be to Him who has provided this for us, though we could never have had it by our own efforts. Surely to our Lord we are returning. O Allah, we ask You for righteousness and piety in this journey of ours, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, lighten for us the hardship of this journey and quickly bring us to our destination. O Allah, You are our Companion on the journey and the Guardian of our families. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel, from a bad return, and from seeing something unpleasant concerning our wealth, family, or children.
adhkar.transliteration: allahu akbar, allahu akbar, allahu akbar. subhanalladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun. allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa wa minal-'amali ma tarda. allahumma hawwin 'alayna safarana hadha watwi 'anna bu'dah. allahumma antas-sahibu fis-safar. wal-khalifatu fil-ahl. allahumma inni a'udhu bika min wa'tha'is-safar wa ka'abatil-mandhari wa su'il-munqalabi fil-mali wal-ahl
adhkar.virtue: Travel Supplication — This supplication has two parts. The first is praise of Allah and the submission of the servant. The second is a request to Allah for ease in travel and in the affairs of what the servant has left at home.
adhkar.source: HR. Muslim

adhkar.arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ وَأَمَانَتَكَ وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ
adhkar.translation: I entrust your religion, your trust, and the end of your deeds to Allah.
adhkar.transliteration: astawdi'ullaha dinaka, wa amanataka, wa khawatima 'amalik
adhkar.virtue: Supplication of a Resident for Someone Who is Traveling — Three priorities of a servant that must be maintained everywhere: religion, trust, and deeds, because a person will be resurrected according to their deeds.
adhkar.source: HR. Abu Dawud: 2601

adhkar.arabic: زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى وَغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ  وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ
adhkar.translation: May Allah provide you with piety, forgive your sins, and ease goodness for you wherever you are.
adhkar.transliteration: zawwadakallahut-taqwa, wa ghafara dhanbaka, wa yassara lakal-khayra haythuma kunta
adhkar.virtue: Supplication for Piety from a Resident to Someone Who is Traveling — Piety is the best provision that a servant must prepare for the Hereafter, because there is no salvation except through piety.
adhkar.source: HR. at-Tirmidzi

adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, to You is all praise. You have clothed me with this. I ask You for its goodness and the goodness for which it was made, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil for which it was made.
adhkar.transliteration: allahumma lakal-hamdu anta kasawtanihi. as'aluka min khayrihi wa khayri ma suni'a lah, wa a'udhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri ma suni'a lah
adhkar.virtue: Supplication When Wearing New Clothes — By reciting this supplication, one asks that the clothes they have bought may provide goodness and also be a protection against various evils.
adhkar.source: HR. Ahmad, Abu Dawud, at-Tirmidzi and Al-Hakim

adhkar.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِى كَسَانِى هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّى وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ
adhkar.translation: Praise be to Allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me without any power or strength from me.
adhkar.transliteration: alhamdulillahilladhi kasani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah
adhkar.virtue: Supplication When Wearing Clothes — The virtue of reciting this supplication is that past sins will be forgiven, Insha Allah.
adhkar.source: HR. all compilers of Sunan books, except Nasa'i

adhkar.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، الحَمْدُ للِه، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ، سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّى قَدْ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى فَاغْفِرْ لِى فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah, in the name of Allah, in the name of Allah. All praise is to Allah. Glory be to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could not have done so by ourselves. And indeed, to our Lord we will return. Glory be to You, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me, for none can forgive sins except You.
adhkar.transliteration: bismillah, bismillah, bismillah, alhamdulillah, subhanalladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin. wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun. subhanaka inni qad dhalamtu nafsi, faghfir li fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta
adhkar.virtue: Supplication When Mounting a Vehicle — By reciting the supplication for mounting a vehicle, our journey will always be under the protection of Allah. In addition, we will also receive rewards, help, and a calmer heart.
adhkar.source: HR. Abu Dawud and at-Tirmidzi

adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
adhkar.translation: O Allah, make it a beneficial rain.
adhkar.transliteration: allahumma sayyiban nafi'a
adhkar.virtue: Supplication When it Rains — It is encouraged to pray when it rains so that goodness and blessings increase, as well as its benefits.
adhkar.source: HR. al-Bukhari No. 1032

adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا ، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ وَبُطُونِ الأَوْدِيَةِ وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, (let the rain fall) around us, not on us. O Allah, (let it fall) on the hills, mountains, small mountains, valleys, and places where trees grow.
adhkar.transliteration: allahumma hawalayna wa la 'alayna. allahumma 'alal-akami wadh-dhirabi, wa butunil-awdiyati, wa manabitish-shajar
adhkar.virtue: Supplication During Heavy Rain — The supplication above is recited when the rain gets heavier or there is a concern that the rain will cause harm.
adhkar.source: HR. al-Bukhari No. 1014

adhkar.arabic: مُطِرْنا بفَضْلِ اللهِ ورَحْمَتِهِ
adhkar.translation: We have been given rain by the bounty and mercy of Allah.
adhkar.transliteration: mutirna bi fadlillahi wa rahmatih
adhkar.virtue: Supplication After it Rains — By reciting this supplication, one believes that rain falls by the will of Allah (Allah's virtue), not by the stars, so they do not become disbelievers in Allah.
adhkar.source: HR. al-Bukhari No. 846 and Muslim No. 71

adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this wind, and I seek refuge in You from its evil.
adhkar.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka khayraha wa a'udhu bika min sharriha
adhkar.virtue: Supplication During Strong Wind — Among the signs of Allah's power is a strong wind that can bring blessings and punishment, namely good and bad. Therefore, a servant should continue to ask for good and seek refuge from all harm.
adhkar.source: HR. Abu Dawud and Ibn Majah

adhkar.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّيْ ، لَا إِلٰـهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِيْ وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ ، أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ ، أَبُوْءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمتِكَ عَلَيَّ ، وَأَبُوْءُ بِذَنْبِيْ فَاغْفِرْ لِيْ ، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no deity worthy of worship except You. You created me, and I am Your servant. I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your blessings upon me, and I acknowledge my sin. So forgive me, for none can forgive sins except You.
adhkar.transliteration: allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa anta khalaqtani wa ana 'abduka wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu abu'u laka bini'matika 'alayya wa abu'u bidhanbi faghfir li fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta
adhkar.virtue: The Best Supplication for Seeking Forgiveness (Sayyid al-Istighfar) — Whoever recites it with certainty in the evening, and then he dies, he will enter Paradise, and likewise if (recited) in the morning.
adhkar.source: HR. al-Bukhari No. 6306, 6323, Ahmad IV/122-125, an-Nasa'i VIII/279-280

adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ سَهْلَ إِلاَّ مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلاً وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلاً
adhkar.translation: O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You make easy, and You make the difficult easy if You wish.
adhkar.transliteration: allahumma la sahla illa ma ja'altahu sahla, wa anta taj'alul-hazna idha shi'ta sahla
adhkar.virtue: Supplication for Ease in All Matters — Ease comes only from Allah. Even something difficult can become easy Insha Allah.
adhkar.source: HR. Ibn Hibban

adhkar.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِى فِى مُصِيبَتِى وَأَخْلِفْ لِى خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
adhkar.translation: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return. O Allah, reward me for my affliction and replace it with something better.
adhkar.transliteration: inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un. allahumma'jurni fi musibati wa akhlif li khayran minha
adhkar.virtue: Supplication When Afflicted by Calamity — A servant should recite the supplication above when afflicted by calamity with certainty and hope. Insha Allah, with this, they will receive a better replacement.
adhkar.source: HR. Muslim

adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِى بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِى بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, suffice me with what is lawful and keep me away from what is unlawful, and enrich me with Your bounty so I do not depend on anyone besides You.
adhkar.transliteration: allahummakfini bi halalika 'an haramik, wa aghnini bi fadlika 'amman siwak
adhkar.virtue: Supplication When in Debt — Lawful provision, even if it is little, is better than abundant unlawful wealth.
adhkar.source: HR. at-Tirmidzi No. 2563

adhkar.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّى أَعُوْذُبِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزْنِ وَأَعُوْذُبِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَأَعُوْذُبِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَأَعُوْذُبِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَتِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرجال
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and grief, and I seek refuge in You from incapacity and laziness, and I seek refuge in You from cowardice and miserliness, and I seek refuge in You from being overpowered by debt and from being overcome by men.
adhkar.transliteration: allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan. wa a'udhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasal. wa a'udhu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhl. wa a'udhu bika min ghalabatid-dayni wa qahrir-rijal
adhkar.virtue: Supplication for Protection from Laziness, Sadness, and Debt — Abu Umamah then narrated: After I practiced this supplication, Allah truly removed my anxiety and gave me the ability to repay my debt.
adhkar.source: HR. Abu Dawud No. 1555

adhkar.arabic: الحَمْدُ للهِ
adhkar.translation: All praise is to Allah.
adhkar.transliteration: alhamdulillah
adhkar.virtue: Supplication After Sneezing — Indeed, Allah loves sneezing because it moves a person to worship. It is encouraged to respond to the praise of Allah by someone who praises Allah, and vice versa.
adhkar.source: HR. al-Bukhari

adhkar.arabic: يَرْحَمُكَ اللهُ
adhkar.translation: May Allah have mercy on you.
adhkar.transliteration: yarhamukallah
adhkar.virtue: Supplication Upon Hearing Someone Sneeze — Indeed, Allah loves sneezing because it moves a person to worship. It is encouraged to respond to the praise of Allah by someone who praises Allah, and vice versa.
adhkar.source: HR. al-Bukhari

adhkar.arabic: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
adhkar.translation: May Allah guide you and improve your condition.
adhkar.transliteration: yahdikumullah wa yuslihu balakum
adhkar.virtue: Response to Someone Who Says 'Yarhamukallah' After You Sneeze — Indeed, Allah loves sneezing because it moves a person to worship. It is encouraged to respond to the praise of Allah by someone who praises Allah, and vice versa.
adhkar.source: HR. al-Bukhari

adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي
adhkar.translation: O Allah, just as You have made my external form good, make my character good as well.
adhkar.transliteration: allahumma kama hassanta khalqi fahassin khuluqi
adhkar.virtue: Supplication for Good Character — A charming appearance is not enough provision for a Muslim, but it must be accompanied by noble character. Therefore, a Muslim should constantly ask for their character to be improved and beautified.
adhkar.source: HR. Ahmad, authenticated by al-Albani in al-Irwa', 1/115

adhkar.arabic: رَبِّ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِيْنِ وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَنْ يَحْضُرُوْنِ
adhkar.translation: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the whispers of Satan, and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, from their presence around me.
adhkar.transliteration: rabbi a'udhu bika min hamazatish-shayatin wa a'udhu bika rabbi ay-yahdurun
adhkar.virtue: Prayer for Protection from Satan — Indeed, Allah commands the Prophet Muhammad and all his followers to seek refuge from the whispers of Satan in all activities, especially when approaching death. Satan whispers evil into the hearts of humans, encouraging wrongdoing.
adhkar.source: QS. Al-Mu'minun: 97-98

adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the established prayer, grant Muhammad the wasilah (a high status in Paradise) and the excellence (above all creation), and raise him to the praiseworthy station that You have promised him.
adhkar.transliteration: allahumma rabba hadhihid-da'watit-tammah, was-salatil-qa'imah, ati muhammadanil-wasilata wal-fadilah, wab'ath-hu maqaman mahmudanilladhi wa'adtah
adhkar.virtue: Prayer After the Adhan — This prayer is recommended by the Prophet Muhammad sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam for those who hear the call to prayer. It has many benefits, including receiving intercession from the Prophet on the Day of Judgment, attaining the wasilah and honor in Paradise for the Prophet, and receiving great and commendable reward from Allah. It is also a way to show respect and admiration for Allah and His Messenger, expressing love and longing for the Prophet Muhammad, the role model for Muslims.
adhkar.source: Narrated by Abu Dawud (529), at-Tirmidhi (211), an-Nasa'i (2:26), Ibn Majah (722)

adhkar.arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ
adhkar.translation: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and all the believers on the Day the account is established.
adhkar.transliteration: rabbanaghfir li wa liwalidayya wa lil-mu'minina yawma yaqumul-hisab
adhkar.virtue: Prayer for Forgiveness for Parents — This is a prayer of Prophet Ibrahim (peace be upon him), teaching us to honor and love our parents, remember the Day of Judgment, and care for fellow believers. By making this prayer, we hope that Allah will forgive our sins and make us among the faithful.
adhkar.source: QS. Ibrahim: 41
